visual.general_description: Line chart of seven clinical indicators at 0 and 24 weeks.
visual.detailed_description: Line chart on a white background with a y-axis titled "Indicators" running 0 to 80 with ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60 and 80, and an x-axis titled "Time/Weeks" running 0 to 30 with ticks at 0, 10, 20 and 30. Seven straight line segments each join a marker at 0 weeks to a marker at 24 weeks. A legend at the right lists BMI(kg/m2) with red squares, HbA1c (%) with green upward triangles, PASI with blue downward triangles, DLQI with pale olive diamonds, CRP (mg/L) with black circles, ALT (U/L) with pink squares and AST (U/L) with salmon stars. At 0 weeks the markers sit at roughly 58 (ALT), 48 (AST), 26 to 27 (BMI and DLQI overlapping), 22 (PASI), 17 (CRP) and 10 (HbA1c). At 24 weeks they sit at roughly 34 (ALT), 26 (AST), 24 (BMI), 8 (DLQI), 7 (HbA1c and PASI) and 3 (CRP). All lines slope downward or stay nearly flat.
